# Palewick Coldstore - plant room

Working folder for the refrigeration team.

- rooms/  cards for each chill room
- plant/  service notes for the compressors

turns.prompt: A refrigeration engineer at Palewick Coldstore asked what the specific heat figure on a chill card is; it is the energy in kilojoules that lifts one kilogram of the product by one kelvin. Room CS-52 takes 620 kilograms of product at 3.6 kilojoules per kilogram per kelvin, to come down from 18 degrees to 4 degrees over a pull-down of 4800 seconds. Give the average refrigeration duty over the pull-down, in kilowatts. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
